reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in the incident channel, in a thread under his message: the depot was Southgate.

Priyanka posted in that channel on 3 Sep 2025 that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with unlabelled boxes stacked by door 4 at Southgate dispatch. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, saying Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a full address for the depot. I also checked the shared files and found no Tansley account folder, so I told him I couldn't find more detail on the site.
